rule.title: A gift of $250 or more needs a contemporaneous written acknowledgment

when_missing.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this a single gift of $250 or more (separate donations are not combined) for which the taxpayer has no contemporaneous written acknowledgment from the charity?

citation.wording: You can deduct a gift of $250 or more only if you have a contemporaneous written acknowledgment from the charitable organization showing the information in (1) and (2) next.
